h1: How do you get approval for a new or widened curb cut in Newton, MA?
title: Newton Curb Cut Permits: Driveway Openings and Engineering Review
description: Learn which City office reviews curb-cut changes and which site and street details need confirmation before applying.
short_answer: Newton Engineering reviews modifications to curb cuts as part of its site-plan and public-way review. A new or widened driveway opening should be discussed with Engineering before construction. The sources reviewed do not establish a single maximum width or intersection-spacing number for every residential property.

facts.text: Newton Engineering reviews site plans that include modifying curb cuts.
Newton zoning contains rules for parking spaces and driveway arrangements. Those rules should not be treated as a universal curb-cut-width standard.

qa.q: Is the residential curb-cut maximum always 20 feet?
qa.a: The cited zoning rule about a 20-foot maximum applies to entrance and exit drives for certain parking facilities, not necessarily every residential curb opening. Confirm the curb-cut standard directly with Engineering.
